explanation: I grepped Mathlib for determinant lemmas about submatrices, block-triangular determinants and reindexing (det_submatrix_equiv_self, twoBlockTriangular_det', det_reindex_self, det_fromBlocks_one₂₂). The nearest match is Matrix.det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Charpoly/Coeff.lean. It says the matrix with identity rows outside a Finset s has the same determinant as the subtype-indexed principal submatrix M.submatrix (↑) (↑) on s. That differs from the target in three ways. The target takes an injective e : Fin r → Fin n and a membership predicate J. It assumes M agrees with 1 off J×J, not that M is a piecewise matrix. It concludes with M.submatrix e e on Fin r, not on the subtype s. Getting from the Mathlib lemma to the target would take several steps. These include rewriting M to the piecewise matrix, re-indexing the subtype s to Fin r by Equiv.ofInjective, and applying det_submatrix_equiv_self. That is more than one or two short lines. The library's own proof also uses the basic block lemmas, not this one.
